global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, amber broth steaming warmly. Topped with vibrant green scallions, a pink swirl fish cake, and dark nori, it sits in a white bowl with red and black kanji, against a soft wooden background under bright, even light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table surface with visible grain pattern and smooth texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red and black Japanese characters, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, golden-brown, creamy texture, surface dotted with oil and floating green garnish.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed: dark, textured, elongated strip with irregular edges and mottled surface patterns.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, soft, spiral-shaped with pink swirl, slightly textured surface.
